prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 公司差旅报销标准 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "费用项目" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 92px
  col 2: header "普通员工" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 170px
  col 3: header "经理" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 223px
  col 4: header "总监" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 202px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按费用项目和员工职级查阅公司差旅报销标准。","reading":"读者先沿首列找到费用项目，再横向比较普通员工、经理和总监的标准；也可能沿某一职级向下查阅各项规定。","groups":["第 2、3、4 列都是职级对应的报销标准，应便于横向比较。","第 1 列是费用项目标签，用来识别和区分各行。"],"keep_intact":["金额、计量单位和数字应尽量保持在一起，例如“500 元/晚”和“80 元/日”。","职级表头和费用项目名称应尽量完整，避免拆散难以辨认的词语。"],"may_wrap":["包含早餐、预订或改签条件等说明可在自然语义边界换行。","同一行中较长标准造成的行高可容纳其他职级标准的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [81, 88, 90, 100] · table 360×498px · row heights [60, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [89, 86, 87, 97] · table 360×474px · row heights [36, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [73, 92, 94, 100] · table 360×498px · row heights [60, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"三个职级列由窄到宽，照顾了总监列较长的条件说明；各行标签与对应标准在视觉上仍能对应。","problems":"首列表头被拆成两行，首列多项费用名称也拆得较碎；金额与“晚”等单位分行，横向比较住宿标准不够顺畅。","cause":"首列宽81px，扣除21px后不足以容纳“费用项目”；普通员工列88px、经理列90px也不足以让部分金额和单位同处一行。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"四个表头都完整显示，表头行紧凑；首列较宽，费用项目更容易辨认，读者能较快定位行。","problems":"正文仍有不少零碎换行：住宿金额与单位分开，总监列的审批和交通条件也被切成多行，横向比较时需要逐行拼读。","cause":"首列增加到89px后，普通员工列和经理列分别缩至86px、87px；总监列97px也不足以完整容纳较长条件。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"职级列得到更多空间，较长标准有一定展开余地；三列标准仍保持相近的视觉权重。","problems":"首列表头换行，费用项目标签被拆得更碎，削弱了定位各行的速度；增加职级列宽度也没有减少主要正文行高。","cause":"首列仅73px，扣除内边距和边框后只剩52px；职级列增加到92px、94px和100px，仍未跨过能明显改变最长单元格行数的宽度门槛。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[89,90,90,90],"change":"保留r2B中能完整显示首列表头的89px，将其余空间均分给三个职级列，检验相同角色的列采用等宽时，金额和条件的换行是否更均衡。"},{"name":"manager-director","widths":[89,84,93,93],"change":"保留完整表头，为内容较长的经理和总监列多分配空间，检验能否改善两列条件说明；同时观察普通员工列收窄后的代价。"},{"name":"director-priority","widths":[89,86,86,98],"change":"以r2B为基础，将1px从经理列移给总监列，检验总监列是否能跨过有意义的换行门槛，同时维持完整表头。"}]}
